paragraphs: In the time of Rava (Bava Metzia 97a): he hired out a mule [to the people of] Bei Chozai; he went out to help lift its load together with them; they were negligent with it and it died; they came before Rava.[^1]

notes.text: צז. gives Bava Metzia 97a conventionally without a fresh passage check. כודנייתא is mule; Bei Chozai remains place/people designation, with to-the-people-of a bracketed contextual supplement. Singular נפק is the owner going out to lift/help raise the load with them, not people going out to unload; plural פשעו refers to hirers’ negligence. Death and coming before Rava remain. Mereimar and Rava are unprefixed names, not standalone Mar/Rav titles, and no new identity binding is made.
